results.title: Missed Call Text Back: Best Tools & Setup Guide [2026]
results.content:
## What Is Missed Call Text-Back?

Missed call text-back is an automated SMS system that sends a text message to a caller the moment their call goes unanswered. When someone calls your business and you don't pick up. whether you're on another call, with a customer, or closed for the day. the system fires an instant text to their number. The caller gets an acknowledgment within seconds rather than reaching dead voicemail, and you stay in contact with a lead who would otherwise be lost. [...] ## How AIRA Solves Missed Calls Before They Happen

Rather than reacting to missed calls with a text, AIRA prevents them. AIRA is an AI receptionist that answers every inbound call to your business. 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including evenings, weekends, and holidays. with no hold time and no voicemail. Callers get their questions answered, their appointments booked, their emergencies routed, and their information collected in real time. [...] Missed call text-back is a reactive system. It waits for a call to go unanswered, then sends a text. By the time the text arrives, the caller has already experienced the friction of not being helped. Research shows that text-back messages receive response rates of 15-25%. meaning 75-85% of callers who receive an automated text don't engage, and many have already called a competitor.

AI call answering is proactive. It answers every call before it becomes a missed call. A caller who reaches an AI receptionist immediately gets greeted by name, has their question answered, their appointment booked, or their emergency routed. all in real time. The call never goes unanswered. The text-back problem doesn't exist because there are no missed calls to follow up on.
